IThe new biome

Cinder's Cradle

Two worlds stacked on one another, stitched together by tendrils of Shroud reaching for a sacred light.

North past the newly opened gates of Veilwater Basin. In size it lands between Blackmire and Veilwater, and it carries 12 new Shroud Roots, a new faction, a new survivor who knows the Ancients' recipes, and a whole crafting tier of gear, food, arrows and spells.

Below

The burning waste

Lava rivers through barren ground and ruins, some swallowed by the Shroud, some simply lost to time.

Above

The lifted isles

Floating islands raised by the Ancients, with strange fauna, intricate architecture and guardians that do not yield.

IIAtlas of Embervale

Every biome got something

The full map is playable. Old regions stretch to the world's edge, long-sealed doors open as part of the main quest, and most former no-build zones now accept your bases.

IIICombat · the mage update

Open the grimoire

Nine new spells: utility, crowd control, two big area spells, and a whole new school of summons. Hover a card to catch the light.

22Eternal tier 7 spells that never use charges
UpgradeableEternal spells and arrows level up with perks
RebalancedMana and cast time now match damage
PiercingWand heavies hit past the first enemy
IVThe enemy, smarter
37

new faces want a fight

High in the sky, evil hides its strongest champion yet.

They listen. Enemies track you by sound instead of simply knowing where you stand.
They heal slowly. Retreat and they regenerate over time. Rush back to a boss and it is still wounded.
They climb. Melee foes walk, jump or drop to reach you. The high ground is no longer a guarantee.
They recover. Shorter stagger means faster counter-attacks.
VAdvanced Adventure Sharing

Sparkworks

Give your world a nervous system.

Craft the new tools and interactive props, then wire levers, buttons, pressure plates and trigger zones into Switchboxes. Clocks, holds and logic gates decide what happens and when. A 2D graph editor shows every input, output and rule.

InputsLevers, buttons, plates, trigger areas
LogicHold, Clock, NOT, AND, OR, Flip-Flop
OutputsDoors, traps, lights, water, spawners

VIUnder the hood

The world was pretty. Now it shines.

A new “brick renderer” keeps distant terrain and voxel builds detailed instead of collapsing into blocks. Drag across each scene to see the same view before and after.

‹ ›

Biome atmospheres

Each region gets its own light, humidity and sky.

Better global light

Richer Shroud colour, truer light under trees and indoors.

Cheaper shadows

More point lights on screen. Big bases benefit most.

Less memory

Looks better while asking less of your machine.

HDR

Supported, for screens that know what to do with it.

Faster shaders

Much shorter compiles after updates and driver installs.

VIIFully voiced

Hey, listen

Every lore note, letter and book is voiced in English, German and Mandarin Chinese. Queue them up and keep exploring like it is an audiobook. Crafting survivors and major quest-givers finally speak too.
